review_notes: I read the whole file and the `IsLocalDefiningFunction` structure in LeviConvexity.lean. I grepped the library for an existing `IsLocalDefiningFunction.differentiableAt` or `contDiffAt` lemma and found none. The long proofs (`exists_disc_estimate`, `isLeviPseudoconvex_fin`) have no large repeated blocks. The other duplication, such as `|ρ z| = -ρ z`, `0 < -L` positivity steps and `‖(m:ℂ)‖ = m`, is only a few lines of routine calculation. I did not report those because the rubric excludes them. The one reported pattern is small but occurs in four proofs and does not use the proofs' other hypotheses. The only uncertainty is whether a reviewer counts it as "nontrivial"; I did not compile the suggested rewrite.

findings.declaration: IsLocalDefiningFunction.mul_abs_le_infDist / infDist_le_mul_abs / exists_infDist_bounds / exists_disc_estimate (repeated local differentiability of ρ on V)
findings.excerpt:
have hdiff : ∀ y ∈ V, DifferentiableAt ℝ ρ y := fun y hy =>
    (h.contDiffOn.contDiffAt (h.isOpen.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
findings.problem: The same argument is repeated verbatim in three proofs (lines 110–111, 148–149, 206–207) and again inline in a fourth (lines 247–248, via `.hasFDerivAt`). Line 242 repeats the `ContDiffAt` half of it for `p` (`h.contDiffOn.contDiffAt (h.isOpen.mem_nhds h.mem)`). The argument is: C² on the open set V gives `ContDiffAt` at each point of V, and so differentiability there. Each proof re-derives it as a local `have`. The structure `IsLocalDefiningFunction` has no accessor for this, so every consumer spells out the `isOpen.mem_nhds` plumbing and the `1 ≤ 2` side goal.
findings.proposed_change:
Add two lemmas next to the structure (or at the top of this file):
`theorem IsLocalDefiningFunction.contDiffAt (h : IsLocalDefiningFunction U p ρ V) {y : E} (hy : y ∈ V) : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 ρ y := h.contDiffOn.contDiffAt (h.isOpen.mem_nhds hy)`
`theorem IsLocalDefiningFunction.differentiableAt (h : IsLocalDefiningFunction U p ρ V) {y : E} (hy : y ∈ V) : DifferentiableAt ℝ ρ y := (h.contDiffAt hy).differentiableAt (by norm_num)`.
The proof of each is the existing two-line term. Then:
- In `mul_abs_le_infDist`, `infDist_le_mul_abs` and `exists_infDist_bounds`, replace the `hdiff` block by `h.differentiableAt` (for example `fun x hx => h.differentiableAt (hball₀ hx).1`, or `have hdiff := fun y (hy : y ∈ V) => h.differentiableAt hy`). In `exists_infDist_bounds`, `hρcont` becomes `(h.differentiableAt h.mem).continuousAt`.
- In `exists_disc_estimate`, `hρp := h.contDiffAt h.mem`, and `hev` becomes `filter_upwards [h.isOpen.mem_nhds h.mem] with y hy; exact (h.differentiableAt hy).hasFDerivAt`.
findings.benefit: Four proofs no longer rebuild the same open-set/C² plumbing. If the regularity hypothesis of `IsLocalDefiningFunction` changes (for example the order of smoothness), only one place needs editing. Each proof then reads as its own geometry rather than as boilerplate.
